indices.createSql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_materials_canonicalUrl` ON `${TABLE_NAME}` (`canonicalUrl`)

entities.createSql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS4(`title` TEXT NOT NULL, `originalUrl` TEXT, `originalText` TEXT, `fileName` TEXT, `source` TEXT, tokenize=unicode61, content=`materials`)
contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_materials_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `materials` BEGIN DELETE FROM `materials_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_materials_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `materials` BEGIN DELETE FROM `materials_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_materials_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `materials` BEGIN INSERT INTO `materials_fts`(`docid`, `title`, `originalUrl`, `originalText`, `fileName`, `source`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`title`, NEW.`originalUrl`, NEW.`originalText`, NEW.`fileName`, NEW.`source`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_materials_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `materials` BEGIN INSERT INTO `materials_fts`(`docid`, `title`, `originalUrl`, `originalText`, `fileName`, `source`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`title`, NEW.`originalUrl`, NEW.`originalText`, NEW.`fileName`, NEW.`source`); END
